MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 32GB microSD cards feel like natural next purchases because I repeatedly buy 16GB and 32GB cards and adapters for compatible devices.",
    "The HD streaming stick adds a useful function to my existing TV setup, while the HDMI cable fits my repeated need for practical connection accessories."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The monitoring camera does not serve the same purpose as my photography tripods, film, and lens cap; those purchases do not mean I need home surveillance.",
    "The smart speaker, smart plug, and smart display do not address a current need. Buying power strips and a tablet does not mean I want voice control or another screen.",
    "The 16TB drive is far beyond the storage capacity I have been buying, and the 4K streaming stick offers little added benefit for my listed 720p TV."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Alexa devices, although my subsequent purchases were mostly practical accessories.",
    "Broad similarities such as cameras, storage, and power seem to matter too much when the actual purpose and scale of the products differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that support equipment I already own, so compatibility and a clear practical use matter more to me than adding unrelated devices.",
    "My repeated purchases of modest-capacity memory cards are a stronger sign of what I need than a general interest in storage.",
    "Although several streaming sticks could serve my TV, I would choose the latest HD option here rather than buy multiple versions with the same purpose."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my need for storage and connection accessories, but stretch my device purchases into unsupported interest in smart-home equipment and larger upgrades."
}
